question: FIFA world cup 2022 is hosted by which country?
solution:
The correct answer is __Qatar__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The 2022 FIFA World Cup **is** the 22nd edition of the FIFA World Cup** is scheduled to be held** in Qatar.
 
• There will be 32 teams participated in this world cup.
 
• This will be the first World Cup to be held in the Arab world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• FIFA World Cup:

 
 
• It is an international football competition held after every four years.
 
• It was started in 1930.
 
• Most Successful Team: Brazil( 5 times).
 
 
 
• Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA):
 
 
• Headquarters: Zurich, Switzerland.
 
• President: Gianni Infantino.
 
• Secretary-General: Fatma Samba Diouf Samoura
 
• Founded: 21 May 1904
